stem: What is the controlling idea of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Many people believe that student projects such as community gardens are more successful when participatory budgeting is used.

options.label: B
options.text: Participatory budgeting has a long history involving many people across the world in city and school budget planning.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people believe that participatory budgeting is the best way to plan school budgets, because it involves students.

options.label: D
options.text: Participatory budgeting is a way for students to be involved in planning school budgets, but not everyone agrees that the process works.
